title: a withdrawn record is held by nobody
line: a file withdrawn through tools/tombstone.py, its reason and an audit row written and its bytes kept in the archive, is held by no reader: Abram C Brant's memorial, the record his cemetery row and its step held, leaves the row cited, the done step's held rows and the screen's step and run without it, the run's note saying it was withdrawn and why; withdrawn twice it is refused; the plan opens the step it alone closed again; saved again its bytes are attached to nothing; and a takedown removes a file's bytes, its rows and manifest kept

steps.say: Abram C Brant's memorial arrives through the inbox, fulfilling the fetch step of his cemetery row

expect.why: the memorial holds his cemetery row
a done step whose run archived the record, his own as its subject

steps.say: the screen shows the record held on the step and on its run
the owner withdraws the memorial page from the evidence, with the reason

tombstone.reason: harness: the page withdrawn, to walk what a withdrawal changes

expect.why: quarantined by default, and what still rests on it in the tree is named for the owner to decide again

diff.reason: harness: the page withdrawn, to walk what a withdrawal changes

expect.why: one audit row under who withdrew it, holding the reason
quarantined, its bytes stay in the archive
the artifact row stays as written

steps.say: nobody counts it held: his cemetery row is cited again, the done step holds no row, and the screen's step and run carry it no more

expect.why: no step opens the withdrawn record as held
the run stays on the step's log as what happened, saying the file it archived was withdrawn and why

steps.say: withdrawn a second time, it is refused, its tombstone named
the plan opens again the step the withdrawn page alone closed
the same page saved again is attached to nothing, and stays in the inbox
an item's metadata the Archive served, archived and taken down: its bytes removed, its row and manifest kept

expect.why: the row and its manifest stay, saying what was held
